name.en: Federal Highway 145 (La Tinaja–Sayula, and the 145D to Chiapas)
name.zh: 145 号联邦公路（拉蒂纳哈—萨尤拉，及通往恰帕斯的 145D）

aka.en: Carretera La Tinaja–Ciudad Alemán–Sayula (the free road through the Papaloapan basin)
aka.zh: 拉蒂纳哈—阿莱曼城—萨尤拉公路（穿越帕帕洛阿潘流域的免费公路）

aka.en: Autopista La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque; Autopista Las Choapas–Raudales–Ocozocoautla (the tolled 145D)
aka.zh: 拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克高速；拉斯乔阿帕斯—劳达莱斯—奥科索科奥特拉高速（收费路 145D）

tagline.en: A free road built by the Papaloapan Commission across the cane and pineapple lowlands of southern Veracruz, shadowed by a toll motorway that runs on to the isthmus and over the Malpaso reservoir into Chiapas
tagline.zh: 帕帕洛阿潘委员会修建的免费公路，穿过韦拉克鲁斯南部的甘蔗和菠萝低地；与之并行的收费高速一直延伸到地峡，再跨越马尔帕索水库进入恰帕斯

start.en: La Tinaja, Veracruz, at the junction with Federal Highway 150 and the Córdoba–Veracruz toll road
start.zh: 韦拉克鲁斯州拉蒂纳哈，与 150 号联邦公路及科尔多瓦—韦拉克鲁斯收费路交会处

end.en: Near Ocozocoautla, Chiapas, where the toll road 145D from Las Choapas meets the road to Tuxtla Gutiérrez; the free road itself ends at Sayula de Alemán on Highway 185
end.zh: 恰帕斯州奥科索科奥特拉附近，来自拉斯乔阿帕斯的收费路 145D 在此接上通往图斯特拉古铁雷斯的公路；免费公路本身止于 185 号公路上的萨尤拉德阿莱曼

en: The free Highway 145 runs 215.4 km south-east from La Tinaja, on Highway 150 in central Veracruz, through Tierra Blanca, Tres Valles and Cosamaloapan, where it meets Highway 175, across the lower Papaloapan to Tuxtepec in Oaxaca, and on through Loma Bonita, Isla and Juan Rodríguez Clara to Sayula de Alemán on Highway 185, the road across the Isthmus of Tehuantepec.

The number is also carried by the toll road 145D, which the atlas draws as part of the route. Its first piece, La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque, runs 228 km to the petrochemical belt near Minatitlán and Coatzacoalcos: 188 km from La Tinaja to Acayucan and 40 km on to Cosoleacaque. A second piece, Las Choapas–Raudales–Ocozocoautla, leaves the Gulf lowlands near the Tabasco line and climbs about 200 km into the Chiapas highlands, crossing the Malpaso reservoir on the Puente Chiapas.

Together the two toll pieces make the most direct motorway from Mexico City and Puebla to Tuxtla Gutiérrez; when the Chiapas piece opened the press reported that it cut about 100 km and three and a half hours from the journey.
zh: 免费的 145 号公路自韦拉克鲁斯中部 150 号公路上的拉蒂纳哈向东南延伸 215.4 公里，经蒂耶拉布兰卡、特雷斯巴耶斯和科萨马洛阿潘（在此与 175 号公路交会），跨过帕帕洛阿潘河下游到达瓦哈卡州的图斯特佩克，再经洛马博尼塔、伊斯拉和胡安罗德里格斯克拉拉抵达萨尤拉德阿莱曼，接上横贯特万特佩克地峡的 185 号公路。
这一编号也用于收费路 145D，本图集将其画作该路线的一部分。第一段拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克长 228 公里，通往米纳蒂特兰和夸察夸尔科斯附近的石化带：拉蒂纳哈至阿卡尤坎 188 公里，再到科索莱亚卡克 40 公里。第二段拉斯乔阿帕斯—劳达莱斯—奥科索科奥特拉在塔瓦斯科州界附近离开墨西哥湾沿岸低地，攀升约 200 公里进入恰帕斯高地，以恰帕斯大桥跨越马尔帕索水库。
两段收费路合起来构成从墨西哥城和普埃布拉到图斯特拉古铁雷斯最直接的高速公路；恰帕斯段通车时，媒体报道称它使行程缩短约 100 公里、三个半小时。

en: The free road is a work of the Comisión del Papaloapan, the river-basin authority created in 1947 on the model of the Tennessee Valley Authority after the floods of 1944. Among its works in President Miguel Alemán's term were the road from La Tinaja through Tierra Blanca to Ciudad Alemán, near Cosamaloapan, and the road from Ciudad Alemán to Sayula. The 76 km from La Tinaja to Ciudad Alemán, 12 m wide and with five bridges including a steel bridge over the Río Blanco, was opened by Alemán in 1952, according to the Veracruz newspaper El Dictamen.

The toll road came with the first wave of private concessions. La Tinaja–Acayucan and Acayucan–Cosoleacaque were conceded on 27 August 1990, together with Córdoba–Veracruz, to Promotora de Autopistas del Golfo, and La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque began operating on 20 October 1993. Like Gómez Palacio–Corralitos and twenty-one other concessions, it was taken back by the federal government in the rescue decree of 27 August 1997, and on 30 September 2011 it was placed under a sixty-year concession to FONADIN.

The Chiapas piece was finished in 2003. Its centrepiece, the Puente Chiapas over the Nezahualcóyotl (Malpaso) reservoir, is 1,208 m long, with a steel orthotropic deck of 102 segments weighing about 8,900 t that was launched across the piers by incremental pushing; President Vicente Fox and Governor Pablo Salazar inaugurated it on 22 December 2003. In 2020 the ministry put Las Choapas–Ocozocoautla and La Tinaja–Acayucan into a 522.97 km public–private partnership tender, the Paquete Sureste, which Proyectos México now lists as concluded or cancelled.
zh: 免费公路是帕帕洛阿潘委员会的工程。该流域管理机构于 1944 年洪灾之后、仿照田纳西河谷管理局于 1947 年设立。米格尔·阿莱曼总统任内，委员会修建了从拉蒂纳哈经蒂耶拉布兰卡到科萨马洛阿潘附近阿莱曼城的公路，以及从阿莱曼城到萨尤拉的公路。据韦拉克鲁斯报纸《宣判报》（El Dictamen）记载，拉蒂纳哈至阿莱曼城的 76 公里路面宽 12 米，设五座桥梁，其中包括跨越布兰科河的一座钢桥，于 1952 年由阿莱曼主持通车。

收费路诞生于第一批私营特许。1990 年 8 月 27 日，拉蒂纳哈—阿卡尤坎和阿卡尤坎—科索莱亚卡克两段连同科尔多瓦—韦拉克鲁斯段一起特许给“海湾高速公路推进公司”（Promotora de Autopistas del Golfo），拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克于 1993 年 10 月 20 日开始运营。它与戈麦斯帕拉西奥—科拉利托斯等另外二十一项特许一道，在 1997 年 8 月 27 日的收回法令中被联邦政府收回；2011 年 9 月 30 日，又以六十年特许交由国家基础设施基金（FONADIN）。

恰帕斯段于 2003 年建成。其核心工程恰帕斯大桥跨越内萨瓦尔科约特尔（马尔帕索）水库，全长 1,208 米，钢正交异性桥面由 102 个节段组成、重约 8,900 吨，以顶推法逐段推过桥墩；2003 年 12 月 22 日由比森特·福克斯总统和州长巴勃罗·萨拉萨尔主持通车。2020 年，交通部将拉斯乔阿帕斯—奥科索科奥特拉和拉蒂纳哈—阿卡尤坎纳入总长 522.97 公里的公私合营招标“东南包”（Paquete Sureste），“墨西哥项目”平台现将其列为已结束或已取消。

en: The Puente Chiapas carries two lanes on a 10 m deck across nine supports, with six main spans of 168 m and piers up to 89 m high; the piers were built in about 80 m of water using offshore techniques. The steel box deck was assembled in a yard on one bank and pushed across in stages behind a launching nose, steadied by a temporary mast with four pairs of stays. The designers described the 168 m span as a world record for a launched bridge. The Instituto de Ingeniería of the national university, UNAM, chosen by the ministry in late 2002 as principal consultant, checked the welding and monitored the launch. The bridge won the construction chamber's Liberman prize two years after it opened.
zh: 恰帕斯大桥桥面宽 10 米，设两条车道，由九个支承构成，六个主跨各 168 米，桥墩最高 89 米；桥墩采用海洋工程技术在约 80 米深的水中建造。钢箱梁桥面在一岸的场地上拼装，前端装导梁，借一座带四对拉索的临时桅杆稳定，分阶段顶推过河。设计者称 168 米跨度为顶推桥梁的世界纪录。墨西哥国立自治大学（UNAM）工程研究所于 2002 年底被交通部选为主要顾问，负责检查焊接并监测顶推过程。大桥通车两年后获得墨西哥建筑业商会颁发的利伯曼奖。

value.en: 215.4 km for the free road, La Tinaja–Sayula de Alemán; toll road 145D: 228 km La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque, and 197.5 km Las Choapas–Ocozocoautla (FONADIN) or 202 km (UNAM)
value.zh: 免费公路拉蒂纳哈—萨尤拉德阿莱曼 215.4 公里；收费路 145D：拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克 228 公里，拉斯乔阿帕斯—奥科索科奥特拉 197.5 公里（国家基础设施基金）或 202 公里（UNAM）

figures.source: SCT, Datos Viales, as cited in English Wikipedia, Mexican Federal Highway 145; Proyectos México, 0336 La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque; FONADIN concession, Annex B; UNAM Instituto de Ingeniería

why.en: No public figure for the Papaloapan Commission's free road or for the 1990s La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque concession; the only figures found are press reports for the Chiapas piece, below.
why.zh: 帕帕洛阿潘委员会修建的免费公路和 1990 年代拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克特许路段均无公开造价；仅找到恰帕斯段的媒体报道数字，见下文。

label.en: Las Choapas–Ocozocoautla and the Puente Chiapas
label.zh: 拉斯乔阿帕斯—奥科索科奥特拉段及恰帕斯大桥

value.en: Reported at 1,800 million pesos for the bridge and 6,000 million for the motorway (2003); not checked against SCT or FONADIN accounts
value.zh: 据报道大桥造价 18 亿比索、高速公路 60 亿比索（2003 年）；未经交通部或国家基础设施基金账目核实

figures.source: El Turista Chiapas, on the Puente Chiapas

value.en: The free road was built by the federal Papaloapan Commission, and Las Choapas–Ocozocoautla by the federal transport ministry. La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque was a private concession of 1990, rescued by the federal government in 1997 and held since 2011 by FONADIN, paid from tolls.
value.zh: 免费公路由联邦帕帕洛阿潘委员会修建，拉斯乔阿帕斯—奥科索科奥特拉段由联邦交通部修建。拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克为 1990 年的私营特许，1997 年由联邦政府收回，2011 年起由国家基础设施基金持有，以通行费偿付。

figures.source: Spanish Wikipedia, Comisión del Papaloapan; SCT, El Mirador, Grandes puentes carreteros de México; DOF, decree of rescue of concessions, 27 August 1997; Proyectos México, 0336 La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque

value.en: 1,208 m over the Malpaso reservoir; steel orthotropic deck of 102 segments, about 8,900 t, launched by incremental pushing; inaugurated 22 December 2003
value.zh: 跨越马尔帕索水库，长 1,208 米；钢正交异性桥面 102 个节段，约 8,900 吨，顶推法施工；2003 年 12 月 22 日通车

figures.source: UNAM Instituto de Ingeniería, El puente Chiapas (Proyectos 2005–2006); SCT, El Mirador, Grandes puentes carreteros de México

label.zh: 拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克特许

value.en: 228 km of four-lane road; in operation since 20 October 1993; FONADIN concession signed 30 September 2011, to 2071
value.zh: 四车道 228 公里；1993 年 10 月 20 日起运营；国家基础设施基金特许 2011 年 9 月 30 日签署，至 2071 年

timeline.en: The Comisión del Papaloapan is created and begins the road from La Tinaja to Ciudad Alemán.
timeline.zh: 帕帕洛阿潘委员会成立，开始修建拉蒂纳哈至阿莱曼城的公路。

timeline.en: Miguel Alemán opens the 76 km La Tinaja–Ciudad Alemán road.
timeline.zh: 米格尔·阿莱曼为 76 公里的拉蒂纳哈—阿莱曼城公路主持通车。

timeline.en: La Tinaja–Acayucan and Acayucan–Cosoleacaque are conceded on 27 August to Promotora de Autopistas del Golfo.
timeline.zh: 8 月 27 日，拉蒂纳哈—阿卡尤坎和阿卡尤坎—科索莱亚卡克特许给海湾高速公路推进公司。

timeline.en: The La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque toll road begins operating on 20 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 20 日，拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克收费路开始运营。

timeline.en: The concession is rescued by federal decree of 27 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 27 日，联邦法令收回该特许。

timeline.en: Vicente Fox inaugurates the Puente Chiapas over the Malpaso reservoir on 22 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 22 日，比森特·福克斯为跨越马尔帕索水库的恰帕斯大桥主持通车。

timeline.en: La Tinaja–Cosoleacaque passes to FONADIN under a sixty-year concession on 30 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 30 日，拉蒂纳哈—科索莱亚卡克以六十年特许交由国家基础设施基金。

timeline.en: The ministry puts both toll pieces into the Paquete Sureste partnership tender, later dropped.
timeline.zh: 交通部将两段收费路纳入“东南包”公私合营招标，后被搁置。
